verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community comment confirming that AWS runs a public status page at status.aws.amazon.com. The same comment reports that the page shows all services green during real outages, which undercuts the 'real' part of the story. No first-party documentation in the pack describes the status/health surface, per-service history, or post-incident reports. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a health dashboard, per-service incident history, published post-incident reports, and evidence that the status surface accurately reflects outages.

support.subject: As an operations lead, outages are owned in public — a real status/health surface with per-service history and post-incident reports

citations.quote: 100% of the services on https://status.aws.amazon.com are green
